name: Marcin Wielgoszewski
biography: is a security engineer and consultant at Gotham Digital Science. He is a committee member for the OWASP NYNJMetro chapter and has previously spoken at ShmooCon and other OWASP events. His research primarily focuses on software security and assurance.
